notes: loadSlots tolerates three distinct kinds of bad entries without failing the whole directory: a non-directory entry is skipped by the isDir guard (lines 296-299); a directory whose slot.json is missing entirely fails `Data(contentsOf:)` and is skipped via `guard let data = try? ... else { continue }` (lines 301-302); a directory whose slot.json exists but doesn't parse fails the decoder and is skipped via `catch { continue }` (lines 305-311). All three land in the same result: only slot-good survives. Newest-first ordering is exercised separately in load-slots-newest-first-ordering.json to keep this fixture focused on the skip behavior.
